proposals: The Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals should publish an annual import-dependence ratio for each major petrochemical — including styrene, acrylonitrile, bisphenol-A, polycarbonate, MDI, TDI and methanol — so that the bands on this tree can be replaced by official percentages, since India publishes no composite figure for most of these lines.

The Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals should add an ITC-HS 8-digit concordance to its production and capacity statistics, so that domestic output of each product can be matched directly against its DGCI&S import line rather than estimated from industry commentary.

The Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell should publish refinery-wise volumes of naphtha and reformate sent to petrochemical units versus sold as fuel or exported, so that whether petrol-range volume freed by ethanol blending is actually being converted into these import-substituting products can be tracked.
